pins.definition: To carry or take someone or something to the place where the speaker is or will be.
To carry, convey, or deliver something to a place or person.
To carry something here on foot or by hand.

situation: A smiling young woman in a brightly lit modern apartment doorway is holding out a fresh, steaming pie toward the viewer.
subject: the action of carrying something toward the speaker's location
brief: A smiling young woman stands inside a sunlit apartment doorway, her arms extended forward to hand a freshly baked, steaming pie across the threshold toward the viewer. The warm, inviting pastry is the bright focal point held right at the edge of the frame.
prompt: A smiling young woman stands inside a sunlit apartment doorway, her arms extended forward to hand a freshly baked, steaming pie across the threshold toward the viewer. The warm, inviting pastry is the bright focal point held right at the edge of the frame. a mid-century travel poster painted in gouache, rich opaque colour, confident simplified forms with real painted texture, strong diagonal composition. One square illustration. The scene is fully rendered and fully inhabited — no silhouettes, no flat icons, no diagram, no empty schematic space. A single subject dominates the frame and everything else is arranged around it. Absolutely no text anywhere in the image: no letters, words, numbers, captions, labels, signage, logos, watermarks or pseudo-text.

notes: es-ES «traer»: To carry or take someone or something to the place where the speaker is or will be.
de-DE «bringen»: To carry, convey, or deliver something to a place or person.
ru «приносить»: To carry something here on foot or by hand.
